name: BlockBucket – Blocks for Gutenberg Editor
author: GutenSuite

sections.description:
BlockBucket is a WordPress plugin designed to enhance the Gutenberg block editor by providing a collection of advanced, customizable blocks.
It aims to offer users greater flexibility and control over their website design without requiring coding knowledge.

BlockBucket offers a variety of blocks that can be tailored to fit the specific needs of your website, allowing for unique layouts and designs.
The plugin integrates smoothly with the Gutenberg editor, ensuring a cohesive user experience.
Designed with performance in mind, BlockBucket ensures that added functionalities do not compromise site speed.
The plugin is regularly updated to stay compatible with the latest WordPress versions and to introduce new features.

👨‍💻 DOCUMENTATION AND SUPPORT

– If you have any more questions, visit our support on the Plugin’s Forum.

Blocks

  • Call to Action: Easily add and style titles, descriptions, and buttons to convey your message effectively.
    Adjust colors, typography, spacing, and backgrounds to align with your branding.
    Insert and configure the CTA block directly within the Gutenberg editor without additional plugins.

  • Info Box: Adjust colors, typography, spacing, and backgrounds to align with your branding and design preferences.
    links within your info boxes to guide users to other pages or resources.

Dashboard with Block Control

BlockBucket not only offers a growing collection of advanced Gutenberg blocks—it also gives you full control over them with its user-friendly dashboard.
The plugin includes a block manager that allows you to enable or disable individual blocks with a simple switch.
Instantly activate or deactivate any block with a clean, easy-to-use toggle interface—keeping your editor clutter-free.
Only load the blocks you need, reducing unnecessary bloat and improving page speed.

EXPERT SUPPORT

We have a very friendly support team ready to help you out. Ask your questions in the support forum, we will get back to you immediately.
sections.installation:
From within WordPress’ dashboard:

  1. Go to Plugins -> Add New
  2. Search for “BlockBucket”
  3. Click “Install”
  4. Click “Activate”
  5. New Gutenberg blocks will appear!
sections.faq:
How to insert blocks of BlockBucket in your page or post?

Install and activate BlockBucket for Gutenberg on your website. Create a new page and click the ‘+’ sign, and you will find all the creative Gutenberg blocks there. Now click on the block you want to insert in your page and create amazing pages.
